title: SABD - Q2 Aeroporti con ritardi in partenza significativi (TimescaleDB)

panels.title: Voli con ritardo grave (>30 min) nel tempo - finestra 1h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", origin_airport_id::text AS airport, severe_delays FROM q2_results_1h WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Ritardo medio in partenza - finestra 1h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", origin_airport_id::text AS airport, round(dep_delay_mean::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_mean FROM q2_results_1h WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Voli con ritardo grave (>30 min) nel tempo - finestra 6h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", origin_airport_id::text AS airport, severe_delays FROM q2_results_6h WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti per ritardi gravi - finestra 1h (ultima finestra)

targets.rawSql: SELECT airport_rank AS "rank", origin_airport_id, num_flights, severe_delays, round(dep_delay_mean::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_mean, round(dep_delay_max::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_max, delayed_flights FROM q2_results_1h WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM q2_results_1h) ORDER BY airport_rank

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti per ritardi gravi - finestra 6h (ultima finestra)

targets.rawSql: SELECT airport_rank AS "rank", origin_airport_id, num_flights, severe_delays, round(dep_delay_mean::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_mean, round(dep_delay_max::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_max, delayed_flights FROM q2_results_6h WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM q2_results_6h) ORDER BY airport_rank

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti dall'inizio del dataset - global finale

targets.rawSql: SELECT airport_rank AS "rank", origin_airport_id, num_flights, severe_delays, round(dep_delay_mean::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_mean, round(dep_delay_max::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_max, delayed_flights FROM q2_results_global WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM q2_results_global) ORDER BY airport_rank

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti dall'inizio del dataset - cumulative live

targets.rawSql: SELECT airport_rank AS "rank", origin_airport_id, num_flights, severe_delays, round(dep_delay_mean::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_mean, round(dep_delay_max::numeric, 1) AS dep_delay_max, delayed_flights FROM q2_results_cumulative WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM q2_results_cumulative) ORDER BY airport_rank
